scripts.catalog:reseed: pnpm run catalog:delete && pnpm run catalog:seed
scripts.zip: bash -c 'set -euo pipefail; PROJECT_DIR="$PWD"; STAGE="$(mktemp -d)"; OUT="$PROJECT_DIR/tracker-api-lambda-$(date +%Y%m%d-%H%M%S).zip"; echo "Carpeta temporal: $STAGE"; cp -R src package.json pnpm-lock.yaml "$STAGE/"; pnpm install --prod --frozen-lockfile --dir "$STAGE"; ( cd "$STAGE" && zip -qry "$OUT" src package.json node_modules ); ls -lh "$OUT"; unzip -t "$OUT"'
